review: Requirements permit past raw context and future programme ID/channel/airtime. Earlier context study used session-start counts, channel/time score boosts and superseded targets. Corrected interval-unioned temporal occupancy weighted schedule-rate replacement is untested. Not a substitute for required permitted methods.
occupancy: Keep complete valid raw intervals inside past fit window; union across channels per user to prevent duplicate/overlapping viewing double-counting. Split at naive wall-clock hour/day boundaries. Seconds watched per bin divided by actual window seconds available in that bin. Training-only global prior is mean occupancy across raw-history-active training users. Smooth each bin with7 occurrences*3600 seconds at that prior. Empty history receives prior; zero-qualifying-history recommendation fallback unchanged.
schedule: Distinct labelled ID/channel/start/duration airings, complete inside corresponding window. Each airing contributes its mean temporal occupancy over its full duration, splitting hour/day bins exactly. This yields weighted airing count per item/user. Divide by past/future total window days, cap rates2/day. Temporal factor=clip(sqrt((future_weighted_rate+0.2)/(past_weighted_rate+0.2)),0.5,1.5). Blend with incumbent global factor at0.25/0.5. Keep integrated56 decay,MF,confidence and all fusion rules fixed.

Tie higher all-user then smaller blend and simpler24 bins. Reject inconsistent or smaller gains; no grid expansion. Report paired users and past-defined cohorts.
